conclusion.prior_observed_failure: Launcher failed to read/open Riot Client installation metadata and then reported an update failure mentioning RiotClientServices.exe
conclusion.repair_recovery_scope: Native UI reopened as reported; client metadata validity, game launch and Vanguard acceptance were not independently validated

privacy_policy: Closed vocabulary, fixed public code/name allowlists; unknown words and identifiers removed. Auth/identity-context lines excluded. No raw lines, log filenames, account names, emails, tokens, URLs, account paths, process arguments, auth configuration or lockfile values exported.
limits: Latest technical events in the last 30 minutes. Relative timestamps use an explicit start header or clock interpretation checked within two seconds of mtime. Redaction can hide decisive information. File-basename mentions do not imply that file is absent. No UI actions, guest writes, starts or stops. Public metadata-path probes were limited fixed presence/size checks; an empty result does not establish absence of all metadata. State-payload enum mentions do not establish active permission errors.
